bullets: Nigerian Christian communities struck by militia massacres, mass abductions, sexual violence against women in forest captivity, and convert-or-die ultimatums leaving dozens dead and hundreds displaced

Chinese Christians facing widening crackdowns including mass arrests of house church leaders, raids banning worship, elderly believers detained, and a terminally ill pastor denied the right to leave the country
Pakistani Christians trapped under blasphemy laws carrying the death penalty, a minor allegedly coerced into converting, and lawyers defending minorities re-arrested hours after court-ordered release
Indian Christians facing demolition of worship spaces, mob attacks on house churches, beatings, abductions, and government intimidation of Christian educational institutions
Algerian believers arrested on criminal charges for gathering to worship, their freedom and legal standing uncertain
Nicaraguan prisoner of faith gravely ill with kidney failure, denied medicine and medical care during years of imprisonment
Iranian Christian families forcibly evicted from a historic church compound seized by state security forces, the matter unresolved before international bodies
Syrian believers living in fear under a new regime, following the arrest and forced exile of a convert pastor detained without charge
Sri Lankan families bereaved by the 2019 Easter Sunday bombings, seven years on, still awaiting complete justice as convictions are handed down
Indonesian Christians whose approved church construction remains blocked by sustained community opposition exploiting permit technicalities
Canadian family seeking accountability after an elderly Christian woman was euthanised under the state assisted dying program against her stated faith-based wishes
Two million civilians in Gaza facing ongoing airstrikes, acute aid shortages, and collapsing essential services amid a fragile ceasefire.
Ukrainian civilians in multiple cities facing aerial bomb strikes, power and water outages, deaths, and roughly 6,000 residents trapped without food or medicine in occupied southern territory.
Malian soldiers captured and families of more than 100 reported killed after an al-Qaeda-linked group attacked an army camp in central Mali.

Christians and other civilians in Nigeria's north-central and northeastern regions killed, abducted, and displaced by militia attacks, banditry, and ongoing insurgency, with thousands of displaced adolescents still locked out of education.
Civilians in Syria facing armed clan clashes, weapons depot explosions, and families of those killed under the former government's airstrikes awaiting accountability.
Afghan civilians in eastern border provinces killed and wounded in cross-border airstrikes.
Civilians in Iran's southeastern border region caught amid armed clashes between security forces and armed groups.
Myanmar civilians facing repeated military airstrikes causing mass casualties, over 3.7 million internally displaced, and millions of children shut out of education.

Civilians across Ethiopia's regions caught between drone strikes, intercommunal violence, and a newly formed armed coalition threatening renewed conflict, with hundreds of thousands of refugees nearby.
Kenyan soldiers and border communities in coastal and northeastern counties facing suspected militant attacks.
Artisanal miners and civilians in eastern Congo subjected to serious abuses under armed occupation, with protesters in Kinshasa facing tear gas over constitutional changes.
Thousands of Malian and Cameroonian villagers left without food, shelter, or security after armed group attacks on civilians.
Thousands of displaced Sudanese civilians in Darfur and Blue Nile State amid RSF detention abuses, ongoing combat, and uncertain conditions for return.
More than 130,000 Yemenis uprooted by renewed coastal fighting, including thousands who fled by sea, with 13 soldiers killed and Houthi strikes reaching Saudi Arabia.
Somali civilians and peacekeeping beneficiaries facing a fragile security environment as international logistical support winds down.
Colombian families facing child recruitment and killing by armed groups in the Catatumbo region, and residents of coastal cities living under criminal armed-strike threats.
Catholic clergy and faith communities in Mexico facing targeted killings and ongoing cartel violence across multiple states.
Families of 11 people killed at a social gathering in South Africa, and women across the country living in fear amid a pattern of gender-based killings.
Pakistani civilians, police officers, and worshippers in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa killed and wounded in a mosque suicide bombing, and political detainees held in Lahore.
Two people killed and communities affected by large-scale drone strikes on populated areas in Russia.
Thousands of French citizens divided over proposed policing legislation and its implications for civil rights.
Ukrainian rail workers and border communities facing ongoing drone strikes on transport infrastructure.
Thousands of Argentine families affected by economic hardship and austerity measures.
Families in India grieving deaths and injuries after a mudslide swept away workers at a farming site.
Six family members killed in Nigeria when landslide-driven flooding caused a water tank to collapse onto their home.
Families across Japan grieving deaths, searching for the missing, and recovering from deadly flooding and landslides left by a major typhoon.
Residents across multiple states in the United States displaced by flash floods, wildfires, and hillside collapses, facing loss of homes and belongings.
Communities in Russia enduring both severe flooding along major river corridors and critically low water levels on a key inland waterway.
Families in Malaysia, including indigenous communities cut off by floodwaters, sheltering in emergency relief centers after heavy rains.
Grieving families in Nepal still recovering from catastrophic glacier-triggered flooding and landslides that killed more than 1,200 people and displaced countless others.
Coastal communities in Australia under evacuation orders as an out-of-control bushfire threatens lives and homes.
Residents in Indonesia continuing to endure aftershocks following a damaging earthquake sequence, with ongoing risk and uncertainty.
Island communities in Papua New Guinea, Fiji, Tonga, and New Zealand following a series of significant offshore earthquakes across the Pacific region.
